definitions.gloss: school nurse; licensed school health teacher
definitions.explanation: A licensed teacher who staffs a Japanese school's {保健室|ほけんしつ} (health room), handling first aid, illness during school hours, health education, and student wellbeing concerns. Casually referred to as the {保健|ほけん}の{先生|せんせい}.

examples.japanese: {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}した→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Since I had a fever, the school nurse contacted my guardian.

examples.japanese: {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: School nurses are in charge of mental health care as well as first aid.

notes:
{養護|ようご} (care, protection) + ⟦{教諭|きょうゆ}→教諭：30765_kyouyu⟧ (licensed teacher). A formal/administrative title used in laws and official documents. In everyday school life, students and parents almost always say ⟦{保健|ほけん}→保健：11616_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult the school nurse
- {養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: school-nurse teaching license
- スクールナース: school nurse (English loanword, less common)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保健|ほけん}→保健：11616_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: 'health teacher' — the everyday term students use
- ⟦{保健室|ほけんしつ}→保健室：05380_hokenshitsu⟧: the health room (their workplace)
- ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧: nurse — the medical profession in general; not a teaching position
